description: Call this when someone shares or asks about their résumé, for example "check my résumé", "will this get past applicant tracking systems" or "what is wrong with my résumé". Pass the résumé as plain text. Scores it out of 100 with fixed rules, the same text always gets the same score, and returns a pass, partial or fail for each of eleven checks with what was seen and the exact fix. It checks structure and wording (contact details, length, headings, results with numbers, weak phrases, summary, dates, layout). It cannot judge whether experience suits a role. Use the findings to rewrite the résumé; the text is scored once and not stored.

resume_text.description: The résumé as plain text, 400 to 20,000 characters.
